responsibility: Declares the small set of generic GNU-user driver options—posix, profile, pthread, and rdynamic—used by targets that include gnu-user.h. It exists to make those shared userspace-spec options available to GCC’s generated option handling without embedding them in each OS-specific option file.
same_name_distinction: Within the gnu-user same-name pair, this file is just the generated-option input for generic driver switches like posix, profile, pthread, and rdynamic; gnu-user.h is the file that turns those options into actual GNU userspace specs and link behavior.
